sources.title: DeepSeek R1 Guide — The Model That Shocked OpenAI in January 2025
sources.snippet: DeepSeek R1: MIT-licensed reasoning model from China that went viral in January 2025. Architecture, benchmarks vs o1/o3, distilled variants (7B to 70B), free usage, and analysis.

sources.title: DeepSeek-R1-7B: Distilled Reasoning LLM
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-R1-7B is a 7-billion-parameter dense LLM that distills advanced chain-of-thought reasoning into a resource-efficient model. It employs multi-stage teacher training using RL, supervised fine-tuning, and knowledge distillation to deliver transparent, multi-step reasoning. sources.title: Free AI DeepSeek-R1 7B | Free.ai
sources.snippet: About DeepSeek-R1 7B (7B) is a chat model built by DeepSeek. It accepts up to 32K tokens of context per request. Strongest at Reasoning, math, step-by-step thinking. Self-hosted on Free.ai GPUs — runs free against your daily token pool (100 tokens per message). Released under MIT — commercial use permitted on Free.ai.
